performance.scope: 9 complete generated label-heavy queries, both optimized profiles, three repetitions with alternating pair order. Workspace is tracked query memory; elapsed_ns is synthetic query timing, not Agent throughput or process RSS.

limitations: Finite inputs do not prove arbitrary-input equivalence.
Fixture timings and tracked query workspace are not production disk throughput or RSS.
Standalone foreign callers do not qualify a whole foreign Netdata Agent.
Caller ASan/UBSan does not instrument the Rust archive; MSRV is compile-only.
Grouped and nonempty-include label construction retains its existing full-copy/include replacement path.
Input metadata, complete keys and output copies still grow with cardinality; no metadata sharing/provider or raw history change is introduced.
Earlier qualification cohorts preserve their actual source and binary identities.
